title: Conduvera WriterFence
description: Canonical writer fencing and idempotency identity for Conduvera attempts. Data shape only: no runtime state, no execution authority.

claim_owner.description: Identity of the writer holding the claim/lease for this attempt.

claim_lease_until.description: Lease expiry; absent or empty means no live lease.

idem_key.description: Idempotency key binding duplicate dispatches to one attempt.

revision.description: CAS revision counter for fenced writes.
